node.name: Mob_Egg
node.description: Hold down to instantly incubate eggs for your nest in World 4. It'll only use up eggs that you have space to carry, dont worry about wasting these!

quest:Oinkin1.name: Filling_the_Menu
quest:Oinkin1.description: Level up three meals to Lv.2 by delivering them to the Menu Dinner Table in town.

quest:Oinkin2.name: Diner_Deliverer
quest:Oinkin2.description: Upgrade various pet upgrades using Grey DNA and meals.

quest:Oinkin3.name: Recipe_for_Fattening_Pastry
quest:Oinkin3.description: Discover the recipe for Croissants in cooking.

quest:Gobo1.name: Breeding_in_Outer_Space
quest:Gobo1.description: Breed a green mushroom in the Egg Nest station.

quest:Gobo2.name: Intense_Mob_Fighting
quest:Gobo2.description: Back at the Egg Nest station, win the first battle in the grasslands.

quest:Gobo3.name: Squirrel_Tactics
quest:Gobo3.description: Unlock squirrel breeding by getting lucky while breeding the mushroom, and place it in your newly claimed territory. Wait a bit, then claim your spice!

quest:Gobo4.name: Spicy_Cooking
quest:Gobo4.description: At the kitchen, start cooking a new recipe using your spice. Use some of the Ladles Gobo gave you to finish it up instantly!

quest:Gobo5.name: Lab_Experimentation,_Ft._You
quest:Gobo5.description: Upload a few  of your characters to the Lab Mainframe. You'll need more than 1 player uploaded to reach the 1st bonus!

quest:Blobbo1.name: A_Honker_Took_mah_Baby!
quest:Blobbo1.description: My Blobinese is a bit rusty, but I think she's saying her children went running after some Honker Critters, and have been missing ever since. Maybe get some honkers and they'll come back?

quest:Blobbo2.name: Glitter_Critter
quest:Blobbo2.description: Ah I see, she actually said her children love shiny things, and chased after some shiny critters. Bring as many shiny critters as you can, I'm sure they'll come flopping back!

quest:Nebula_Neddy1.name: Task_Requirement_Affirmative
quest:Nebula_Neddy1.description: Gather some monster parts to show you're ready to take on the World 4 tasks!

item:Ladle.name: Cooking_Ladle
item:Ladle.description: Hold down to boost all your kitchens ahead by 1 hour for each ladle in this stack. The entire stack will be used up when you do.

item:Critter8A.name: Jade_Scarab
item:Critter8A.description: Oh I guess this one is a scarab, not a beetle. You can tell because of the way it is.

item:Critter6A.name: Eternal_Lord_of_The_Undying_Ember
item:Critter6A.description: Bow before the destroyer of all that lies outside his domain, the ruler of the 8th dimension and all that it's flame encompasses, the bringer of light to the blind, and darkness to those who recite his title in full. ...ah crap.

item:Critter3A.name: Crescent_Scorpie
item:Critter3A.description: This chrome coloured scorpion came straight from the future! Fuuuutuuuuureee! FUUTUUURREE!!! SOMEONE DIRECT ME TO THE CAN OPENERRRR!!!!

item:PureWater2.name: Dense_Water
item:PureWater2.description: It's like a bowl of oatmeal, but double the thiccness and hold the oats.

item:GalaxyA1.name: Purple_Mush_Cap
item:GalaxyA1.description: According to herblore books, this purple cap is sterile. Those purple fungi that grow from the ground, however, will mutate if exposed to toxic oil radiation.

item:GalaxyA2.name: TV_Remote
item:GalaxyA2.description: Oh, THATS where he put the remote, all the way out here in outer space thousands of miles from the surface! Oh that silly man!

item:GalaxyA3.name: Half_Eaten_Donut
item:GalaxyA3.description: WAIT NO STOP! Don't eat the rest of this donut! Think about it... if it was really worth eating, why was it left like this, all un-eaten and such? Think before you eat!

item:PetEgg.name: Mob_Egg
item:PetEgg.description: Hold down to instantly incubate eggs for your nest in World 4. It'll only use up eggs that you have space to carry, dont worry about wasting these!

pageProps.seoDescription: Mob Egg is a Legends of Idleon item: dropped by 1 monster, quest reward, sold in shops. Hold down to instantly incubate eggs for your nest in World 4. It'll only use up eggs that you have space to carry, dont worry about wasting these!
